rows.ProposalDescription1:
Qualifications

General Information

This proposal is based on plans prepared by: Emerge Design, sheets 1 thru 3, Dated: 9/3/2026

Landscape Install

This proposal reflects the plant schedule quantities shown on the plans. Shortages and undersized plant material are common in the landscaping industry due to current market conditions; therefore, height of shrubs per required container size cannot be guaranteed. This proposal may include increased container sizes to meet the requested specifications shown on the plant schedule. An add/deduct price can be provided for an additional cost. Mulch shall be Cocoa Brown Mulch 2 CF Bag per schedule.

Soil Samples & Amendments

Soil testing analysis results will determine if drainage sump gravel or amendments are necessary. Soil testing will be provided at no additional cost to the owner and/or developer. It is more cost effective to add sump gravel or amend soils with fertilizers and nutrients, should results show any deficiencies. These items can be provided for an additional price on “as needed” basis.

Sod Install

Sod shall be Bahia Sod per the schedule. Sod quantities are estimated. The actual quantity used may be different. The contractor may request additional areas for the sod to be installed at the same square foot price contracted through this scope of work. It is not a common industry practice to roll Bahia sod after installation. It can be provided at an additional price. A color-out attachment has been provided to show sod areas Juniper has included in this proposal.

Exclusions

This proposal does not include an arborist quote, tree protection, herbicide, or soil remediation.

Substitutions

Arbor-Brace tree anchoring system may be required depending on the availability of lumber for the 2 X 4 tree staking. Fertilizer type is not specified; therefore, this proposal includes Agriform Tablets 20-10-5 as the Fertilizer.


Irrigation Install

Irrigation estimate based on Juniper Design/Build

Water source has been determined and defined within the civil plans as Potable 1” metered water source providing 25 GPM @ 55 PSI.

Juniper Landscaping shall not be liable for POC's ability to produce the volume of water required and/or the quality of water.

The irrigation price does not include the price of a backflow. Juniper does not install backflows. This should be installed by a certified plumber.

Power to irrigation controller to be provided by others.

All Landscape is hydro-zoned.

Irrigation Main line, valves and lateral lines on irrigation plan are shown in schematic form ONLY.

Estimate does NOT include any directional boring or concrete cutting.
